import hashlib,itertools,json,math,os,sys,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
for key in ('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS'):os.environ[key]='1'
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm,logm
started=time.monotonic();source=Path(__file__).read_bytes();input_path=Path(sys.argv[1]);raw=input_path.read_bytes();cap=json.loads(raw)
expected='bd4d5e1d0e9fcfadef72cc9dba2cc4f7e6efacc6a577ee331fcd5b82574e5e49';assert cap['capsule']['source_sha256']==expected
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='centre-physical-frozen-') as directory:
    replay=Path(directory)
    for name,text in cap['capsule']['source_bytes_at_IMPORT'].items():
        assert Path(name).name==name and hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()==cap['capsule']['source_sha256_at_IMPORT'][name]
        (replay/name).write_text(text)
    sys.path.insert(0,str(replay))
    import covariant_root_transfer as root
    from covariant_induced_photon import Parameters,phi_frame
    gamma,_=phi_frame(Parameters());_,basis=np.linalg.eigh(gamma[0]);frame=np.column_stack((basis[:,2:],basis[:,:2]))
    gb=np.array([frame.conj().T@g@frame for g in gamma])
    constraints=np.vstack([np.kron(g.conj().T,np.eye(4))-np.kron(np.eye(4),g) for g in gb])
    _,_,vh=np.linalg.svd(constraints,full_matrices=False)
    UT=vh[-1].conj().reshape(4,4,order='F');UT*=2/np.linalg.norm(UT);UT*=np.exp(-.25j*np.angle(np.linalg.det(UT)))
    UT_error=max(float(np.linalg.norm(UT@g.conj()@UT.conj().T-g)) for g in gb)
    assert UT_error<1e-12 and np.linalg.norm(UT@UT.conj()+np.eye(4))<1e-12
    R=-1j*gb[1]@gb[2]@gb[3];CH=R@UT
    model=root.BosonicEdgeModel(4,((0,1),(0,2),(0,3)));N=sum((model.n(i) for i in range(4)),np.zeros_like(model.identity))
    indices=np.flatnonzero(abs(np.diag(N)-2)<1e-12);selector=np.eye(model.dimension)[:,indices];d=len(indices)
    E={}
    for i,j in itertools.product(range(4),repeat=2):
        one=np.zeros((4,4),complex);one[i,j]=1;E[i,j]=selector.conj().T@root.native_lift(model,one)@selector
    constraints=np.vstack([np.kron(E[i,j].T,np.eye(d))-np.kron(np.eye(d),(np.eye(d) if i==j else 0)-E[j,i]) for i,j in E])
    _,_,vh=np.linalg.svd(constraints,full_matrices=False);PH=vh[-1].conj().reshape(d,d,order='F');PH*=math.sqrt(d)/np.linalg.norm(PH)
    PH_error=max(float(np.linalg.norm(PH@E[i,j]@PH.conj().T-((np.eye(d) if i==j else 0)-E[j,i]))) for i,j in E)
    assert PH_error<1e-12
    PHfull=selector@PH@selector.conj().T
    empty=np.flatnonzero(abs(np.diag(N))<1e-12)[0];filled=np.flatnonzero(abs(np.diag(N)-4)<1e-12)[0]
    PHfull[empty,filled]=1;PHfull[filled,empty]=1
    GH=expm(root.native_lift(model,logm(CH)));Cbase=GH@PHfull
    p=np.array([.3,.2,.1])
    tplus,bplus,_=root.wilson_step(gamma,.01,1.,p);tminus,bminus,_=root.wilson_step(gamma,.01,1.,-p)
    Tplus=bplus*expm(root.native_lift(model,root.positive_log(tplus)))
    Tminus=bminus*expm(root.native_lift(model,root.positive_log(tminus)))
    onebody_error=float(np.linalg.norm(CH@np.linalg.inv(tminus).T@CH.conj().T-tplus))
    base_error=float(np.linalg.norm(Cbase@Tminus@Cbase.conj().T-Tplus)/np.linalg.norm(Tplus))
    assert onebody_error<1e-12 and base_error<1e-12
    generator=np.diag([-.4,.2,.3,-.1]).astype(complex);generator[0,2]=generator[2,0]=.7;generator[1,3]=generator[3,1]=.3
    generator/=np.linalg.norm(generator)
    L=root.native_lift(model,1j*generator)
    neutral=selector.conj().T@Tplus@selector;_,vectors=np.linalg.eigh(neutral);v=selector@vectors[:,-1]
    rows=[]
    for coordinate in (-.7,-.2,0.,.4,.9):
        Q=expm(coordinate*L);Q_tau=expm(-coordinate*L);derivative=L@Q
        physical=Q@Tplus@Q.conj().T;physical_tau=Q_tau@Tminus@Q_tau.conj().T
        Cphys=Q@Cbase@Q_tau.conj().T
        potential_error=float(np.linalg.norm(Cphys@physical_tau@Cphys.conj().T-physical)/np.linalg.norm(physical))
        transported=Q@v;dpsi=derivative@v
        minus=dpsi-derivative@Q.conj().T@transported
        wrong_plus=dpsi+Q.conj().T@derivative@transported
        old_pulled=Q.conj().T@v
        old_pulled_plus=(-Q.conj().T@derivative@Q.conj().T)@v+Q.conj().T@derivative@old_pulled
        centre=[]
        for z in range(4):
            qz=expm(1j*math.pi*z*N/2);qz_tau=expm(-1j*math.pi*z*N/2)
            Cz=(qz@Q)@Cbase@(qz_tau@Q_tau).conj().T
            centre.append(float(np.linalg.norm(Cz-Cphys)))
        assert potential_error<1e-12 and np.linalg.norm(minus)<1e-12 and max(centre)<1e-12
        rows.append(dict(orientation_coordinate=coordinate,physical_potential_C_error=potential_error,
            corrected_Dminus_transported_sea_derivative_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(minus)),
            frozen_Dplus_on_actual_physical_sea_derivative_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(wrong_plus)),
            Dplus_on_opposite_frame_sea_derivative_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(old_pulled_plus)),
            all4centre_singlevaluedness_max_error=max(centre)))
    assert max(r['frozen_Dplus_on_actual_physical_sea_derivative_norm'] for r in rows)>1
    result=dict(source_bytes=source.decode(),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
        input=dict(path=str(input_path),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),frozen_root_sha256=expected),
        runtime=dict(executable=sys.executable,python=sys.version,numpy=np.__version__),
        primitive_even_full_dimension=model.dimension,UT_gamma_intertwiner_error=UT_error,
        actual_primitive_unitary_PH_matrixunit_error=PH_error,locked_T1_unitary_C_onebody_error=onebody_error,
        actual_full_primitive_transfer_unitary_C_error=base_error,actual_orientation_and_centre_cases=rows,
        recombined_operator_proof='NEW intended physical Dminus=Q dQdag=d-(dQ)Qdag, physical T=Q T0Qdag, Cphys=Q C0 tau* Qdag. Qdag Dminus Q=d and Qdag Cphys Q=C0tau*; tau isometry preserves covariant Dirichlet energy. C0 T0(tau)C0dag=T0 proves potential covariance in SAME physical frame. For tauV=V*, PH Gamma(V^T)PH^-1=Gamma(Vdag) (detV=1), hence onebody Wphys=V C_H Vdag. Centre z contributes z^(4-N)z^N=z^4=1.',
        frozen_withdrawal='The frozen written plus connection annihilates Qdag v, not the actual physical transported sea Qv of potential Q T0Qdag. Pure-gauge kinetic C_D alone therefore does not certify the frozen joined potential+kinetic bundle.',
        scope='Executed actual primitive and varying physical-orientation recombination for proposed NEW connection repair. It is not implementation or retag of frozen Root. Whole repaired field/Gauss/CP capsule, current couplings and charged Ref3 halfsteps remain Root/Alpha owners obligations.',
        elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(output=sys.argv[2],source_sha256=result['source_sha256'],primitive_transfer_C_error=base_error,
        corrected_sea_derivative=max(r['corrected_Dminus_transported_sea_derivative_norm'] for r in rows),
        frozen_wrong_sea_derivative=max(r['frozen_Dplus_on_actual_physical_sea_derivative_norm'] for r in rows),
        physical_potential_C_error=max(r['physical_potential_C_error'] for r in rows),
        centre_error=max(r['all4centre_singlevaluedness_max_error'] for r in rows),elapsed_seconds=result['elapsed_seconds'])))
    print('Natural exit: actual physical-potential/connection recombination for NEW repair; frozen epoch not retagged')
